# IDENTITY_OPERATOR

The identity operator's CRDs are established, so its CRs can be applied.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `identityOperator`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.identityOperator`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
